title: PAUSE CARD AS A BUTTON COLUMN
why: Critic c-31 (pause 25/42/49 at 2): a cheat-sheet legend, an explaining sentence and a row of mixed buttons. The card is now the title over one column of 56px sentence-case buttons at the menu width, Abandon set apart, no legend or sentence on a keyboard card (a pad keeps its legend).
now: The pause screen is a clean button column.
